QuestInfo.name: [Golden Temple] Where's My Keepsake
QuestInfo.0: Noi is looking for a missing Well-Kept Keepsake.
QuestInfo.1: Find the Well-Kept Keepsake that disappeared from the Golden Temple and return it to Noi.
QuestInfo.2: You returned the Well-Kept Keepsake to Noi. It seemed like it was a treasured possession... where did that monk disappear to, leaving such object behind?

0.0: All those monks that Ravana and his minions defeated... They'll never admire my cuteness again... It makes me want to cry. If you find any of their belongings--maybe something shiny--bring it to me. I want something to remember them by.

no.0: But how else will I remember all those who used to pamper me?

1.0: That belongs to one of the monks that went missing! I'll keep his stuff safe until he returns. He WILL return. My cuteness demands it...

item.0: Please look for anything that might belong to one of the missing monks. It's the only thing I have to remember them by...
